			modifier = { factor = 0 war_exhaustion = 3 }
			modifier = { factor = 0 num_of_rebel_controlled_provinces = 1 }
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_burghers loyalty = 45 } } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 is_at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 2 OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_frontier_legacy has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_bureaucratic_legacy } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 treasury = 750 }
			modifier = { factor = 1.4 monthly_income = 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 1.3 estate_influence = { estate = estate_burghers influence = 50 } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.3 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4 }
			modifier = { factor = 1.25 jxp_tenka_order_at_least_50 = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 1.25 jxp_imperial_sanction_at_least_50 = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 1.25 jxp_oceanic_opening_at_least_50 = yes }
		}
	}

	jxp_a_audit_company_registry = {
		major = no
		potential = {
			jxp_a_is_domestic_economy_country_trigger = yes
			jxp_a_company_has_at_least_1_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_audit_regime }
		}
		allow = {
			adm_power = 75
			treasury = 100
			NOT = { is_bankrupt = yes }
		}
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_bureaucratic_legacy
						has_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict
					}
				}
				add_adm_power = -50
				add_treasury = -75
			}
			else = {
				add_adm_power = -75
				add_treasury = -100
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_chartered } jxp_a_audit_company_mining_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_chartered } jxp_a_audit_company_shipping_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_chartered } jxp_a_audit_company_rice_credit_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_chartered } jxp_a_audit_company_textile_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_armaments_chartered } jxp_a_audit_company_armaments_effect = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0.75
			modifier = { factor = 2 num_of_loans = 3 }
			modifier = { factor = 2 corruption = 5 }
			modifier = { factor = 2 OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_distressed has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_distressed has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_rice_credit_state_distressed has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_textile_state_distressed has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_armaments_state_distressed } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 jxp_a_company_has_at_least_3_trigger = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = jxp_a_unification_method_edict }
			modifier = { factor = 1.4 has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_bureaucratic_legacy }
			modifier = { factor = 0.35 is_at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 num_of_rebel_controlled_provinces = 1 }
		}
	}
